name: Lim Chee Kin Portfolio
description: Portfolio of Lim Chee Kin — AI Solutions Architect at Daxonet AI specialising in enterprise AI agents, RAG and voice AI. This static site does not accept A2A task requests: read the data from the JSON API (/api/portfolio.json) or the read-only MCP server at https://kin.rag.wtf/mcp. A second MCP server at https://kin.rag.wtf/mcp/hire runs the HIRE check (should an AI agent be built or kept?); the same check is a web tool at https://kin.rag.wtf/hire/.

extensions.description: This agent's data is served over MCP, not A2A: a read-only, stateless Streamable HTTP server (POST only, no auth) with tools get_projects, get_project, get_experience, get_articles, search_portfolio, get_contact_info.

skills.name: Portfolio Data Retrieval
skills.description: Structured portfolio data (projects, work experience with responsibilities, articles, contact) from the static JSON API. Full: /api/portfolio.json; per collection: /api/projects.json, /api/experience.json, /api/articles.json. Described by /api/openapi.json. Search index: /api/search.json.
examples: Which projects did Lim Chee Kin build at Daxonet AI?
List his work experience, newest first.

skills.name: MCP Tools
skills.description: Read-only MCP server at https://kin.rag.wtf/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, POST only, no auth): tools get_projects, get_project, get_experience, get_articles, search_portfolio, get_contact_info, plus portfolio:// resources. Example calls: tools/call search_portfolio {"query": "MCP"}; tools/call get_project {"slug": "claim-pilot"}.

skills.name: HIRE Check
skills.description: MCP server at https://kin.rag.wtf/mcp/hire (Streamable HTTP, stateless, POST only, no auth; manifest /.well-known/mcp-hire.json) that decides whether an AI agent should be built (HIRE, TRAIN or DO NOT BUILD) or, once live, kept (HIRE, TRAIN or FIRE): tools get_hire_checklist, assess_agent. Pure computation; the answers are never stored or logged. Same check as the web tool at https://kin.rag.wtf/hire/. Example calls: tools/call get_hire_checklist {}; tools/call assess_agent {"isLive": false, ...answers in the checklist's flow order}.
examples: Should we build an AI agent for our support queue?
Is our live fraud-review agent ready to keep, or should we retrain or retire it?

skills.name: Content Discovery
skills.description: Discover every page and agent resource through /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /sitemap-index.xml and /rss.xml. Each project, article and the About page also has a Markdown version at <page URL>index.md.
examples: Where is the full portfolio as text?
